label: verify-quick
detail: Runs format check, Release build, and non-Office unit tests (~10 s).

label: verify-full
detail: Runs format/analyzer check, Release build, non-Office tests with coverage, and hygiene checks (~60 s). Use test-all or scripts/verify-office.ps1 for OfficeIntegration tests.

label: test
detail: Runs all non-Office tests (dotnet test, OfficeIntegration excluded).

label: test-all
detail: Runs all tests including OfficeIntegration (requires Microsoft 365 on Windows).

label: build
detail: Release build with warnings as errors.

label: build-clean
detail: Cleans and rebuilds the Release configuration.
